metadata.overview: A simulated mining container for the Operation Center Lite dev stack: one per container, reporting the container's own temperature and humidity the way the Bitdeer and Antspace container workers do (snap stats.ambient_temp_c, stats.humidity_percent), and its PDU sockets the way the Bitdeer worker does (snap stats.container_specific.pdu_data). Read-only; it has no commands.

telemetry.name: snap
telemetry.description: Every reading in one call, in the container workers' snap shape: { stats: { status, ambient_temp_c, humidity_percent, container_specific: { pdu_data } }, config }.

errors.ERR_DEVICE_CALL_FAILED: The simulator's HTTP API call failed or returned an error.
